events.description: A person fires a handgun indoors; muzzle flash is visible at the barrel tip.
A person fires a handgun indoors; muzzle flash and smoke are visible near the barrel.
A person fires a handgun indoors; clear muzzle flash and recoil visible.

Two individuals engage in mutual physical combat: one in a black top and skirt attacks and evades while the other in a light shirt and dark pants pursues, throws objects, and attempts to strike; the interaction includes dynamic movement, dodging, and reciprocal aggression.

Two individuals engage in a dynamic, physical fight inside a bedroom: one person (in white shirt and black pants) jumps onto the bed and attacks the other (in black crop top and skirt), who defends and counters; the struggle includes grappling, pushing, and movement across the room and bed, with visible motion blur indicating rapid action.

A man and a woman engage in mutual physical combat: the man grabs the woman, she resists and strikes back with a knife-like object, they grapple near the bed, and she eventually gains control while he is on the floor.

After initial mutual struggle, the woman appears to overpower the man and repeatedly strike or press him down while he is on the floor (visible in f4–f5), suggesting he is no longer able to effectively resist, meeting the definition of attacking a helpless victim.
A man in a white shirt is seen holding a woman by the hair and pressing her against a wall, indicating physical control and assault.
A close-up shows a hand gripping a modified pistol with dual barrels; the weapon is pointed at a person in darkness, consistent with an imminent or ongoing shooting action.
Two men fire handguns at each other from opposite sides of a wall; visible muzzle flashes and sparks indicate active gunfire.
A man fires a rifle (likely an AK-47) with a visible muzzle flash while standing on a rooftop, aiming downward at an opponent.
A woman is thrown or pushed off a rooftop by a man; the sequence shows her being launched into the air over the edge, indicating physical combat resulting in a fall.
A man fires an assault rifle; muzzle flash and smoke are visible at the barrel as he aims at a concrete wall with bullet impacts.
A woman in black attacks a man on the ground; she delivers kicks and strikes while he is down, attempting to rise and defend himself.

The man, now on his knees and visibly injured (blood on sleeve), is being attacked by the woman who continues to strike and taunt him; he is defenseless and trying to reach a guitar case for a weapon.

A person in a white shirt is on the ground, struggling to open a guitar case while being attacked or pursued by a woman in a black dress who lunges toward them; physical contact and aggressive motion are evident across frames f0–f2.
Two men engage in a gunfight: one in a light shirt fires a rifle while the other, wearing a hat and green shirt, returns fire with a handgun; muzzle flash and recoil are visible in frames f8–f13.
A large explosion erupts behind two men, propelling them backward through the air; bright fireball, smoke, and debris confirm a sudden blast event.
Two men engage in a gunfight: one in a light shirt fires a rifle while the other, wearing a hat and green vest, returns fire with a pistol; muzzle flash and recoil are visible across frames f0–f5.
A large, sudden explosion erupts behind the two men, propelling them backward mid-air; bright fireball and debris confirm a detonation event (not sustained fire).
The gunfight includes close-quarters physical struggle: at f4–f5, the man in the hat grabs and shoves the shooter, indicating mutual physical combat beyond mere shooting.

A large, sudden fireball erupts from behind a concrete wall, expanding rapidly and filling the background with intense orange flames and smoke; this is a classic explosive ignition event, not sustained fire.
